none: PAS NLM-004DC6: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: Nottinghamshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Beata Tranquillitas issue of 321-323, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust draped and/or cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TIN[--]. Reverse description: Globe on altar inscribed VOT/IS/XX. Reverse inscription: BEATATRAN QVILLITAS. Diameter: 18.8mm, Weight: 1.85gms, die axis: 6
